name: hw-cpu
description: The 8-bit multicycle accumulator CPU of the hardware demonstrator (plan of 2026-10-21, §8 D4): the HwDesign metamodel built from nothing, and the model cpu over its three concerns: the ISA (one format oooo aaaa, ten instructions), the datapath (PC, IR, ACC, Z, the ALU, two muxes, a ROM and a RAM of 16 cells, ports and wires), the control (11 states, one cycle each, the register transfers as exit actions, 20 transitions with opcode guards and an else to FETCH for the six undefined opcodes); the program in the ROM multiplies 7 by 6 by repeated addition into RAM[12], and Play runs it to HALT..

values: Z.[value] := if (ram.cells.filter(c => c.addr == IR.[value].slice(3, 0).toNumber()).first.[value]) == bits(8, '0x00') then bits(1, '0x1') else bits(1, '0x0')
Z.[value] := if (ACC.[value] + ram.cells.filter(c => c.addr == IR.[value].slice(3, 0).toNumber()).first.[value]) == bits(8, '0x00') then bits(1, '0x1') else bits(1, '0x0')
Z.[value] := if (ACC.[value] - ram.cells.filter(c => c.addr == IR.[value].slice(3, 0).toNumber()).first.[value]) == bits(8, '0x00') then bits(1, '0x1') else bits(1, '0x0')
Z.[value] := if (ACC.[value].and(ram.cells.filter(c => c.addr == IR.[value].slice(3, 0).toNumber()).first.[value])) == bits(8, '0x00') then bits(1, '0x1') else bits(1, '0x0')
Z.[value] := if (IR.[value].slice(3, 0).zext(8)) == bits(8, '0x00') then bits(1, '0x1') else bits(1, '0x0')
PC.[value] := if Z.[value] == bits(1, '0x1') then IR.[value].slice(3, 0) else PC.[value]
